title: Rakuten Securities second report: about 4.41 million records with names and addresses leaked, including about 1.19 million for people with no account
what_changed: Second report of 24 Nov (Impress Watch): about 11.98 million accounts with customer code and login ID; about 4.41 million records with names, birth dates, addresses, phone numbers (about 1.19 million for people without an account), replacing the earlier up-to 4.47 million / 11.25 million figures.
